abstract: Agent skill for Axolotl, the YAML-driven LLM fine-tuning framework: install with uv or Docker, write and debug configs, LoRA/QLoRA/full SFT, DPO/KTO/GRPO with vLLM, multi-GPU with FSDP2 and DeepSpeed, merge-lora and GGUF export, troubleshooting and updating. References split by install, config, RL, multi-GPU, export, troubleshooting and updating, plus an FP8 merge-and-serve combo and two config templates.
